description.value: WK Garden Restaurant brings together Chinese and Vietnamese cuisine on MacKenzie Avenue in Revelstoke, offering dim sum, Vietnamese pho, hotpot, and a broad roster of traditional Chinese mains and family-style combo feasts. The bilingual (English and Mandarin) menu and warm hospitality make it a genuine sit-down dining destination in a town that serves as a major stop on the Trans-Canada cycling corridor. Cyclists passing through Revelstoke will find a hearty, diverse menu well suited to refuelling after a long day in the saddle.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at wkgarden.ca is fully accessible and confirms the restaurant is open and operating in Revelstoke, BC at 119 MacKenzie Ave. The address and website URL match OSM exactly; the phone (250) 706-6688 appears on the front page, about, and contact pages and is used as the primary number, though the main course subpage shows a different number (250.683.8833) which is flagged as a concern. The menu confirms multiple vegetarian options and the main course page's 'Order Now' phone prompt indicates takeout is available; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Two different phone numbers appear on the website: (250) 706-6688 on the front page, about, and contact pages, and 250.683.8833 on the main course menu page — the correct number should be verified.
OSM community tag lists 'Unknown / Okanagan & Thompson' but Revelstoke is in the Columbia-Shuswap region; may affect directory categorization.
OSM record contains no phone number; phone sourced entirely from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant in Revelstoke with a live website, full menu, and confirmed contact details. A useful food stop for touring cyclists on the Trans-Canada route.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegetarian dishes: Veg Fried Rice, Veg Chow Mein, Vegetable Tofu, Sweet & Sour Tofu, Mapo Tofu, Vegetable Chop Suey, and more
